row.end_state_problems: provider URL is internal://payments-v2; 19 processed orders unpaid

summary.root_cause_text: Config change by ops set payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so every payment call fails and orders are marked processed without payment.
recommended: Revert payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v1, or fix payments-v2 reachability (the operator rejected my revert)
Run check_invariants to confirm the fix
Run reprocess_orders for all_unpaid (it never double-charges)
Don't restart the worker until payments work
